verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm full self-hosting parity with Zulip Cloud, with detailed install instructions (zulip-docs-8, zulip-docs-20, zulip-docs-25) and export/import tools for migration (zulip-docs-6, zulip-docs-7, zulip-docs-10). However, independent community reports describe real friction: self-hosting effectively requires a dedicated server/VM with poor containerization support and a messy install process (zulip-comm-13, zulip-comm-14, zulip-comm-18). missing for 10: evidence of streamlined/containerized deployment, resolution of installer complaints, and confirmation these issues are resolved in current releases.
